annotation.title_clean: 国家发展改革委 民政部 国家卫生健康委关于进一步完善价格形成机制 推动普惠养老服务提质扩面的指导意见
annotation.title_en: Guiding Opinions of the NDRC, Ministry of Civil Affairs and National Health Commission on Further Improving Price Formation Mechanisms and Promoting Quality Improvement and Expansion of Inclusive Elderly Care Services
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家发展改革委; 民政部; 国家卫生健康委
annotation.summary_en: Chinese national guideline from NDRC, Ministry of Civil Affairs and National Health Commission on pricing for elderly care services. It classifies institutions by type, sets government-guided or market pricing, and requires cost surveys, monitoring, fee-list disclosure and support for inclusive services. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Classifies elderly care institutions as safety-net, inclusive-support or fully market-based, each with its own pricing regime.
Government-guided prices are set from cost surveys on a 'cost compensation, reasonable profit' principle.
Requires price monitoring and periodic policy evaluation at least every three years.
Institutions must publicly post fee catalogues and may not charge fees outside them.
Directs investment, bond and lottery fund support to inclusive elderly care and to nursing staff training.
